texts.orig: 1. Carrier agrees to transport the shipment described above under the broker-carrier agreement on file. Payment terms are net 30 days from receipt of a signed bill of lading and this confirmation. Quick pay is available at 2% with a 48-hour turnaround. Carrier must call in at pickup and delivery and report any delay longer than one hour. Double brokering is prohibited and voids payment.
